metadata.description: Captured GET /api/mdm/updates/deployments/{uuid} immediately after create against 26.4.0.0. Confirms Questions A and B: (A) uuid field IS present on the wire ("uuid":"...") and ranking IS present ("ranking":1); (B) priority key is COMPLETELY ABSENT — not null, not "UNKNOWN", simply omitted — consistent with the 26.2.0.0 finding that NullValueHandling.Ignore drops unset optional fields. Also confirms: allow_user_deferral and max_number_of_deferrals are omitted (never set by V1 create). All real UUIDs anonymized, including smart_group_uuids (corrected: an earlier pass of this fixture left the real sdk-test-smartgroup-2 UUID in place).
